rubric.statement: Uses `_get_stream_completion_fn(request, {}, sync=False, headers=custom_headers)` under a patched `dspy.settings` with a non-`None` `send_stream` and `caller_predict = None`, so DSPy's async streaming helper is exercised offline instead of returning `None`.
Stubs `litellm.acompletion` with an async iterator, awaits the returned stream function, and reads `mock_acompletion.call_args.kwargs` (or equivalent) as the exact kwargs DSPy streamed to LiteLLM.
Turns `dspy.settings.track_usage` on and asserts that DSPy injects `stream_options == {'include_usage': True}` into the streamed request kwargs.
Asserts that the streamed call's `headers` still contain the supplied `Authorization` bearer token, proving the custom header is preserved.
Stubs `litellm.stream_chunk_builder` to a fixed object and asserts the awaited stream function returns that object, confirming the mocked streaming path completes end-to-end.
